correctness.rationale: At frozen RESULT.md blob d83a9b64f6809c0ca339b2c03f451ecd0482b7ce, independence and stationary OU covariance yield C_a(t)=(r e^{-at}+a q(t))/(r+a), r=A/B. Direct quotient differentiation gives sign F_a(t)=e^{at}q(t)-1-(a+r)t. If a<=b=inf supp ν>0, F_a<0. If a>b, F_a(0)=0, F_a'(0)=-(r+Eβ)<0, F_a''(t)=∫(a−β)^2e^{(a−β)t}ν(dβ)>0, and positive spectral mass β<a forces growth, proving exactly one positive crossing. At crossing ∂_a F=t²(a+r)>0 gives decreasing t_*(a); endpoint limits and the inverse t→0 law follow from q(t)=1−Eβ t+o(t). Laplace–Stieltjes integration by parts and ν([b,b+h])~Kh^κ give q(t)~KΓ(κ+1)e^{-bt}t^{-κ}; substituting the exact root yields the long-lag (κ+1)log(t)/t correction and the stated constant. The finite 3-rate numbers in source are examples, not proof. Checked fixed A,B,ν, positive t, κ=0 atom, and κ>0 edge.
